title.it: Open Air Rave Stage — Festival Peak
title.en: Open Air Rave Stage — Festival Peak

audioSetup: D&B Audiotechnik J-Series Line Array, 8x B22 Sub, Pioneer CDJ-3000 + DJM-A9

notes.it: Slot serale ad altissima intensità. Scaletta serrata da Festival Techno a 135 BPM verso Hardstyle e Rawstyle con kick devastanti a 155 BPM. Reazione travolgente del pubblico.
notes.en: High-intensity evening festival slot. Relentless progression from 135 BPM Festival Techno to 155 BPM Hardstyle & Rawstyle kicks. Outstanding crowd energy.
